title: NIST SP 800-61r3：分流、決策與事件交接
titleEn: NIST SP 800-61r3: triage, decisions and incident handoffs
subcategoryTitle: 偵測品質、事件分析與鑑識
subcategoryTitleEn: Detection quality, incident analysis and forensics
summary: 分開偵測、確認、範圍判斷與遏止決策，為每步保留時間、負責人、證據與未確定事項。
summaryEn: Separate detection, acknowledgment, scoping and containment decisions, recording time, owner, evidence and uncertainty.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

options: 若將第一個警示當事件起始，會混淆偵測延遲與回應延遲；未知起始時間應明示未知。

NIST將事件回應融入風險管理；本課用無攻擊程式的桌上事件卡練習交接。
optionsEn: Treating the first alert as incident onset confuses detection delay with response delay; unknown onset must remain unknown.
Before isolation, assess service impact and evidence preservation under assigned decision authority; actions here remain tabletop.
NIST integrates incident response into risk management; harmless tabletop event cards exercise handoffs.
